events.description: Render and initialize the Spring-Mass System with a block and a parametric spring coil.
events.clip_query: A spring-mass system with a grey spring and a blue block labeled m is displayed on screen.

events.description: Animate the spring-mass system oscillating with real-time physics simulation via updaters.
events.clip_query: The spring-mass system oscillates back and forth horizontally.

events.description: Display a family of complex solution curves (e.g., spirals or rotating vectors in the complex plane) representing the complex roots of the characteristic equation.
events.clip_query: A set of colorful spiral curves or rotating vectors representing complex solutions are drawn on a coordinate plane.

events.description: Show the transition or projection of these complex solutions into the real-valued physical oscillation of the mass.
events.clip_query: The complex vectors project onto the real axis, matching the physical motion of the oscillating mass.
